verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at learn.chatgpt.com (HTTP 200), and the doc pages are published as .md URLs an agent can fetch. However, the llms.txt content shown is framed around Codex rather than ChatGPT as a whole, and the only evidence is the probe; no first-party page documents agent-oriented docs as a feature. missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt covers the full ChatGPT documentation rather than just Codex, first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown docs offering, an OpenAPI or other machine-readable spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
